entries.description: Probabilistic ranking using term frequency, document frequency, and document length normalisation. Controlled by k1 (term saturation) and b (length normalisation) hyperparameters.
Bi-encoder architecture encodes query and document independently. FAISS or ScaNN for approximate nearest-neighbour search at scale.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion score = sum(1/(k+rank)) across lists. k=60 is empirically robust. Requires no score normalisation.
Full attention over (query, document) joint encoding. Slower than bi-encoder but more accurate. Used in second-stage re-ranking of top-50 candidates.
